messages:
ravi: kicking off a config-only rollout during the late change window. goal: reduce tail and unit cost for short requests. changes: max_concurrency 55 -> 33, global_timeout 68s -> 48s, batch_window 11ms -> 4ms, enable per-tenant spillover with spill_threshold 0.95. change window 23:40-00:20 PT. canary plan: 0.75% -> 7% -> 100%. release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-thinburst
release-manager: copy. please attach preflight checklist here and pin fallback route policy route:stable-2 before canary. abort gates: p95 +17% OR 5xx_rate >0.45% sustained 2m. add quick rollback command to top of thread.
kelly: will post preflight. small asks: split canary across 4 AZs, spread across instance pools a/b, and pre-warm top tenants. warm script: /ops/warm_kv_top.sh. also prepare soft-throttle command if needed: `rb config patch --batch_window_ms=2 --max_concurrency=25`.
deploybot: deploybot: release "thinburst-config-2026-03" queued by ravi. pipeline: validate -> canary(0.75%) -> wait(9m) -> canary(7%) -> wait(16m) -> ramp(100%). preflight smoke: running.
deploybot: preflight smoke: OK (auth, quick-gen, embed-check)
sre: monitoring set: p95_latency, p99_latency, 5xx_rate, kv_cache_miss_rate, gpu_mem_pct, tenant_5xx. alerts: 5xx >0.45% for 2m OR p95 > baseline*1.17. pager if tenant_5xx spike >1% for any tenant.
kelly: warm_kv_top for tenants alpha,beta,gamma now. pin fallback route route:stable-2.
deploybot: canary(0.75%) started at 23:43:12 PT across 4 AZs and two instance pools. monitoring.
ravi: quick config snippet I'm applying:
```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 33,
  "global_timeout_s": 48,
  "batch_window_ms": 4,
  "spillover": {"spill_threshold": 0.95, "spill_policy": "spill-to-default"},
  "routing_weights": {"canary-thinburst": 0.75, "default": 99.25}
}
```
deploybot: canary(0.75%) held 9m and passed gate. no abort triggers. proceeding to 7% at 23:53:30 PT.
kelly: re-running warm for top tenants before 7%.
sre: initial look: p50 down ~5%, p95 flat, kv_cache_miss +14% (expected). no 5xx.
deploybot: canary(7%) in progress.
kelly: at 7% we see tenant "big-cust" show a 2.4% tenant_5xx and malformed large batches. applying `tenant-exclude big-cust` and routing that tenant to route:stable-2.
sre: tenant-exclude big-cust applied. also enabled a tenant-scoped soft-throttle for big-cust shard: batch_window_ms 4 -> 2 and max_concurrency 33 -> 26.
deploybot: tenant-exclude and soft-throttle applied for big-cust. monitoring.
release-manager: decision: hold at 7% for the full 16m observe. if system-wide 5xx breaches, fallback global traffic flip command is `rb traffic swap --policy route:stable-2 --all` (clipboard-ready).
ravi: noted. I have the rollback command ready.
sre: after soft-throttle big-cust tenant_5xx dropped back to 0.3% within 3m. system 5xx under threshold. p95 trending down.
deploybot: canary(7%) passed gates. preparing ramp to 100% at 00:12:05 PT.
kelly: small ops note: if GPU mem pressure >84% and p95 climbs try soft-throttle cluster-wide: `rb config patch --batch_window_ms=3 --max_concurrency=28` before full rollback. add to runbook.
release-manager: agreed. set a hard rollback cutoff at 00:18 PT to give oncall time if needed.
deploybot: ramp to 100% started at 00:11:58 PT. final healthchecks running.
sre: post-ramp quick checks: p95 improved ~8% vs baseline, p99 slightly improved, kv_cache_miss normalized, 5xx stable 0.12%. cost-per-request trending down.
ravi: closing change window early at 00:15 PT. tagging config commit cfg@9f8e7d and updating release notes with tenant-exclude and soft-throttle mitigation steps.
release-manager: thanks team. will publish post-deploy summary tomorrow AM and mark release: success. :white_check_mark: 
kelly: updating runbook with tenant-exclude flow, soft-throttle commands, and quick rollback CLI.
sre: saving perf snapshot to perf-archive/thinburst/2026-03 and archiving logs for big-cust for follow-up. closing thread.
